prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: game lobby cover and loading artwork, landscape 4:3. Image 1 is the edit target; image 2 is the exact new player identity. Replace the teal old character at left with the cream paper rabbit from image 2, retaining its oval black eyes, pink inner ears, coral scarf and charcoal wax-crayon outlines. The rabbit is jumping rightward, slightly larger and central-left. Replace the paper airplane above the middle-right platform with an orange carrot projectile. Add one precious golden carrot floating clearly above a teal platform near the rabbit, with a soft golden radiant halo and small star gleams. Preserve image 1's warm ruled notebook paper, ascending teal platforms, spring, shield and coral one-eyed monster, paper cutout/crayon texture, playful clear composition. Do not add text or UI or watermark. Flat 2D paper illustration, no 3D. Full opaque cover, same 4:3 framing.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: rare collectible sprite for paper rabbit jumping game. Edit target is this golden carrot. Make this instantly recognizable as a precious golden treasure, distinct from an ordinary orange carrot. Preserve carrot silhouette and teal leaf crown, angled slightly to the right, bold charcoal wax-crayon outline, warm flecked paper cutout style and cream paper rim. Change the root to luminous metallic yellow-gold with amber facets, a broad ivory gleaming highlight and clean sparkling gold surface; a little jewel-like shine, three small crisp four-point gold/ivory star glints around it. No face, labels, text, crown, coins or container. Keep a clear carrot, strong readable shape at 54 px tall. Isolated actual transparent RGBA, no large glow background; a separate halo will be drawn by the game. One sprite centered with transparent margin.

Use case: compositing. Asset: one complete rabbit-with-rocket player sprite. Image 1 is the exact cream rabbit identity; image 2 is a matching teal/coral paper rocket reference. Draw one naturally integrated illustration of the SAME rabbit riding and holding a small upright rocket: rocket below the rabbit's body, rabbit's front paws grip the upper rocket, knees/feet straddle its upper side fins, rabbit's chest/head/face and long ears remain fully visible above the rocket nose. Use a compact rocket with teal body, coral nose and coral side fins, golden trim, charcoal crayon outlines and cream cut-paper rim. No giant empty black porthole over the rabbit, no disconnected limbs or floating rocket pasted over its face. Rabbit cream fur, oval black eyes, pink inner ears, coral scarf facing right, keep facial expression and proportions. Entire rabbit plus entire compact rocket visible as a single game sprite with generous transparent margins on a portrait composition inside the canvas. Maintain flat paper/crayon texture. Do not include flame/trail, background, text, watermark or extra characters; flame is separate animation. Actual transparent RGBA.

Use case: compositing. Asset: one complete rabbit-with-jetpack player sprite. Image 1 is the edit target and exact rabbit identity; image 2 is the jetpack equipment/style reference. Preserve the rabbit face, long pink inner ears, cream fur, oval black eyes, coral scarf, proportions, paper texture and crayon cutout style. Rabbit body and front paws remain fully visible; no pack pasted over its face. Matching flight pose with feet slightly trailing down. One continuous integrated illustration, flat 2D, charcoal outline and ivory cut-paper edge. Full rabbit and gear visible with transparent margin; no flame/trail, text, watermark, extra characters or background. Actual transparent RGBA.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: flame-only effect sprite that is drawn under the integrated rabbit jetpack. Edit target is the old two-nozzle flame sprite. Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset: flame-only rocket propulsion effect drawn at the rocket's bottom nozzle.
